content: Google Code Wiki: auto-generated structured wiki per repo, refreshes after every commit, auto-updated architecture diagrams, Gemini chat assistant with links into code, public preview for OSS, Gemini CLI extension for private repos in development. DeepWiki (Cognition): zero-setup wiki for any GitHub repo, self-hostable (DeepWiki-Open), multi-LLM providers, RAG Q&A, Mermaid diagrams, private repo support. Both are read-only generate-then-browse; no comment loop, no human decision layer, no cross-repo consistency.
